meta.description: Orlando's results-focused football coach. Measurable performance gains backed by data.

about.name: Coach Aaron Mitchell
about.title: Performance Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Aaron Mitchell blends sport science with old-school football fundamentals to produce measurable, trackable results. Every athlete in his program is assessed at intake, re-evaluated every four weeks, and exits with verifiable proof of improvement — on paper and on the field. His data-first approach has earned him a reputation as Orlando's most accountable football trainer.

hero.headline: Measure It. Improve It. Prove It.
hero.subline: Football performance coaching with real data, real benchmarks, and real results.

services.title: Performance Assessment
services.description: Baseline testing: 40-yard, vertical, agility, strength — full report delivered in 48 hours.

services.title: Individualized Training Plan
services.description: 12-week plan built from your assessment data. Every session has a measurable target.

services.title: In-Season Maintenance
services.description: Weekly sessions focused on injury prevention, load management, and game-week activation.

success_stories.story: 8 weeks of sprint mechanics and hip activation work. Tyler earned a starting spot at his high school after training.
Plyometric progression and posterior chain strength built over 10 weeks. Recruited by two D2 programs.

faq.question: What does the assessment include?
faq.answer: 40-yard dash, 3-cone, vertical jump, broad jump, grip strength, and a movement screen. You receive a written report within 48 hours.

faq.question: How often will my athlete be re-evaluated?
faq.answer: Re-assessment every 4 weeks. You'll see the delta on every metric so you always know the program is working.

faq.question: Do you work with athletes who are currently in-season?
faq.answer: Yes — the In-Season Maintenance program is designed for athletes who need to stay sharp without overloading during their competitive season.
